competitors.name: EasyCargo
competitors.summaryEn: EasyCargo is an established browser-based load planning tool with per-seat licensing (day tickets, monthly or yearly), a 10-day free trial, and support for trucks, containers and pallets.
competitors.summaryZh: EasyCargo 係老牌瀏覽器裝載規劃工具,按席位收費(日票、月費或年費),有 10 日免費試用,支援貨車、貨櫃同卡板。
theyHaveEn: Truck types and pallets as first-class vehicles
Established customer base and long track record
theyHaveZh: 老牌產品,客戶基礎成熟
團隊/企業授權(企業級 $2,400+ 起)
competitors.pricingEn: Paid per-seat licenses (day tickets, monthly, yearly; prices shown in their store). Free trial is 10 days.
competitors.pricingZh: 按席位收費(日票/月費/年費,價錢喺佢哋商店顯示),試用期 10 日。

competitors.name: Cargo-Planner
competitors.summaryEn: Cargo-Planner is a polished commercial load planning platform for sea, road and air with an embeddable SDK/API, used by large forwarders and airlines. Pricing is subscription-based via custom tiers.
competitors.summaryZh: Cargo-Planner 係精緻嘅商用裝載規劃平台,覆蓋海運、陸運、空運,提供可嵌入 SDK/API,大型貨代同航空公司都有採用。訂閱制,價錢按方案報價。
theyHaveEn: SDK/API for embedding into your own systems
theyHaveZh: 企業客戶群(航空公司、全球貨代)
competitors.pricingEn: Subscription plans (quote-based tiers); free trial available.
competitors.pricingZh: 訂閱制(按方案報價),有免費試用。

competitors.name: Cube-IQ
competitors.summaryEn: Cube-IQ (MagicLogic) is enterprise desktop load-optimization software with deep constraint support, frequently cited among the most advanced packers. Third-party listings report pricing from roughly $5,000/year per user.
competitors.summaryZh: Cube-IQ(MagicLogic)係企業級桌面裝載優化軟件,約束支援極深,常被評為最強算法之一。第三方目錄顯示價格約每用戶每年 $5,000 起。
theyHaveEn: Very deep constraint engine (mixed vehicles, complex rules)
Desktop + database integrations for enterprise ops
theyHaveZh: 約束引擎極深(混合載具、複雜規則)
桌面 + 數據庫整合,面向企業營運
competitors.pricingEn: Enterprise licensing; third-party listings report from ~$5,000/yr per user (verify with vendor).
competitors.pricingZh: 企業授權;第三方目錄顯示約每用戶每年 $5,000 起(以官方報價為準)。

competitors.name: Goodloading
competitors.summaryEn: Goodloading is a browser-based cargo planning app for road, sea and air. It offers free registration with an always-free demo version and a paid professional tier, and covers axle pressure, permissible total weight and centre of gravity, multi-stop loading, 3D visualisation with a loading animation, and sharing by link or PDF.
competitors.summaryZh: Goodloading 係瀏覽器裝載規劃工具,支援陸運、海運同空運。免費註冊、demo 版一直免費,另有付費專業版;涵蓋軸重、總許可重量同重心、多點裝卸、3D 視覺化連裝載動畫,可用連結或 PDF 分享。
theyHaveEn: Axle pressure, permissible total weight and centre of gravity
Multi-stop loading with cargo separated per drop
Loading animation in shared projects and PDFs
theyHaveZh: 軸重、總許可重量同重心計算
多點裝卸,每個卸貨點分開擺放
分享項目同 PDF 內置裝載動畫
competitors.pricingEn: Free registration with an always-free demo version; a paid professional version adds advanced customisation (prices on their site).
competitors.pricingZh: 免費註冊,demo 版一直免費;付費專業版提供進階自訂功能(價錢見官網)。

competitors.name: 3DBinPacking
competitors.summaryEn: 3DBinPacking is a cloud packing-optimisation service with an API, aimed at box selection and load planning. It offers a 14-day trial with no credit card required, states all tools are included in every subscription plan, and advertises an average calculation time under 0.1 second.
competitors.summaryZh: 3DBinPacking 係雲端裝箱優化服務,附 API,主打選箱同裝載規劃。有 14 日試用、唔使信用卡,聲明所有工具喺每個訂閱方案都包,並標榜平均運算時間少於 0.1 秒。
theyHaveEn: Box-selection tools (find a box size, try out box sizes)
Pallet stacking and max-load checks as separate tools
Established commercial API with published documentation
theyHaveZh: 選箱工具(搵合適箱、試唔同箱)
卡板堆疊同最大裝載檢查獨立工具
成熟商用 API,有正式文檔
competitors.pricingEn: Subscription plans (all tools included in each plan); 14-day trial, no credit card required. Current prices on their site.
competitors.pricingZh: 訂閱制(每個方案都包晒所有工具);14 日試用、唔使信用卡。價錢以官網為準。

competitors.name: CargoWiz
competitors.summaryEn: CargoWiz is a Windows desktop container-loading calculator that positions itself as the easiest to learn. It has a drag-and-drop editor, Excel import, and a "Spread My Cargo" function for weight distribution, with a fully-featured 30-day trial download.
competitors.summaryZh: CargoWiz 係 Windows 桌面貨櫃裝載計算軟件,主打易學易用。有拖放編輯器、Excel 匯入,同埋「Spread My Cargo」重量分佈功能,提供 30 日全功能試用下載。
theyHaveEn: Windows desktop app that runs without a browser or internet
Excel import and a drag-and-drop cargo editor
Fully-featured 30-day trial; support free for the first year
theyHaveZh: Windows 桌面程式,唔使瀏覽器或上網都用得
Excel 匯入 + 拖放式貨物編輯器
30 日全功能試用;首年免費支援
competitors.pricingEn: Paid Windows licence after a 30-day fully-featured trial; the vendor does not publish a price on the product page (verify with vendor).
competitors.pricingZh: 30 日全功能試用後需購買 Windows 授權;官網產品頁未有公開價錢(以官方報價為準)。
